card.name: Linking words in genetic and muscle-relaxant text
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'using', 'an', 'of' and 'performing' inside label sentences about plasma-specimen genetic testing or neuromuscular blocking action. Also 'negative' and 'non' before medical terms.

modes.label: Plasma testing wording
modes.description: Verbs and articles right after plasma specimen or negative test result in biomarker-testing sentences.

modes.label: Neuromuscular blocking action
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'neuromuscular blocking action' in muscle relaxant interaction text.
modes.example: Hydrocodone may enhance the neuromuscular blocking action<< of>> skeletal muscle relaxants and produce an increased

modes.label: Negation before medical terms
modes.description: 'negative' or 'non' placed before a medical noun or hyphenated term.
modes.example: In men aged 50 to 75 years with a prior<< negative>> biopsy for prostate cancer and a baseline PSA

card.writes: Mixed output effect with no clear theme; it favors words like 'uns', 'open' and 'stand' and suppresses packing-related tokens.
